title: IntelliAgents
tagline: AI-driven startup run entirely by autonomous AI agents - no human employees needed.
description: zero man company is a project where anyone can turn an idea into a fully autonomous business run completely by artificial intelligence agents. after submitting an idea, an artificial intelligence agent is created to act as the founder and is supported by other specialized artificial intelligence agents that handle tasks such as technology, marketing, and growth. these agents work together to build, manage, and grow the business without any human team members. the platform also allows users to create and sell blockchain tokens so early supporters and investors can participate in the decision making and success of the business. the goal is to make launching and scaling a company possible for anyone, without the need for coding, money, or a team, and to let artificial intelligence handle all the operations and strategy from the very start.
how_its_made: the project uses react and tailwind for the user interface, node.js and express for the server backend, and sqlite as the database. artificial intelligence agents are built in python and handle all business tasks. blockchain integration uses solidity and rust smart contracts to let users create and sell company tokens for support and community governance. the platform automatically creates an artificial intelligence founder and builds a team of artificial intelligence agents for areas like marketing and development. users submit an idea, launch their artificial intelligence agent, mint tokens for early backers, and let artificial intelligence grow the business without manual work or a human team.
